title: Event schedule
description: Schedule + room/speaker/session model for the .eventSchedule custom editor. Mirrors src/event/schedule.ts.

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp; the editor refreshes this on each save.

seed.description: Deterministic PRNG seed (used by the Regenerate Tools button).

name.description: Event name; downstream tools use this as the top-level folder name.

days.description: Three-letter day labels in order (e.g. MON, TUE, WED).

defaultTimeslots.description: Default timeslot labels used to seed newly-added days. Absent/empty falls through to the deterministic config-derived list (timeslotsForDay).

titleSlides.description: Title-slide template binding. Populated by the 'Bind title-slide template' action in the editor; consumed by the title-slide generator. Absent means no template is bound yet.

templatePath.description: Path to the template .pptx, relative to this .eventSchedule file.

fields.description: Ordered field bindings. Speaker entries determine per-slide speaker capacity.

role.description: What this frame's text is populated with at generate time.

frame.description: Zero-based index of the text frame on the template slide (document order).

line.description: Speaker bindings only: zero-based line within a multi-line frame. Line-bound speakers substitute text in v1 but do not get hyperlinks (per-line overlay deferred).

position.description: Speaker bindings only: 1-based position. Determines which session speaker (1st, 2nd, …) lands in this frame at generate time. Falls back to array-order position when omitted (legacy bindings).

distributeEvenly.description: When a session's speaker count exceeds capacity, distribute as evenly as possible across slides (true) vs. fill-then-remainder (false, default). 5 speakers @ capacity 4 → [3, 2] vs [4, 1].

timeslotsByDay.description: Per-day ordered timeslot labels. Authoritative for grid row order in the .eventSchedule editor. Each value is the day's labels in display order.

title.description: Optional free-form meeting title. When empty / missing the editor displays `kind` in its place.
